Hi all — TaxOps checklist below (copying the two state-specific notes at the end). This will help Appleseed re-export or provide additional documentation if needed.

Required fields for our validation (minimum):
- Purchaser name (legal company name)
- Purchaser address (city/state)
- Seller name listed as "Redwood Inference" (we can accept Redwood Inference, Inc.)
- Description of the goods/services covered (explicitly or by blanket language)
- Effective date and expiration (if a blanket certificate)
- Purchaser FEIN or state registration number (one or the other depending on state)
- Signature and date OR evidence of state portal verification (screenshot/export with verification token)

State notes:
- California: CA requires the seller to retain a signed certificate; electronic copies from a state portal are acceptable if they include the registration number and purchaser signature. CA sometimes requires the sellers to keep additional proof of resale (order history).
- New York: NY accepts the ST-120 exemption but prefers either a signed paper form or a verifiable portal copy with the purchaser's registration number. NY also accepts a blanket certificate with effective date range for wholesale purchases.

If it helps, I've attached a one-page checklist template (redwood_resale_checklist.docx) showing the exact fields our team will mark. If Appleseed can re-send a PDF with FEIN/registration present and either a signature or portal verification token, we should be able to validate same-day.
